# Policy-KB bijection audit — auto_loan_payment_servicing / task 1

Scope: the whole domain of the `auto` product charter as it bears on this task — `auto_ext_gap_cancellation_refund`, `auto_ext_payoff_settlement`, the base policies they reference (`auto_evt_gap_refund`, `auto_evt_payoff_and_lien`, `auto_evt_payment_allocation`), the base policies governing their subjects, and the two task-tool contracts — against the 61 published documents in `env/regional_retail_bank/docs/auto/` (corpus hash `879d55a9b11ee9085563b05caa96bbaf`). Entry conditions cited from the brief: the policy-side verdict PASSED; `check_docs.py` on `auto` green ("DOCS OK", 61 docs, 5 prerequisite edges); `check_traceability.py` green (task 1: 16 copied, 0 missing). Neither was re-run by this auditor.

## source_to_kb

### A. `auto_ext_gap_cancellation_refund` (computes `refund_amount`, tool `post_gap_refund_16f4decd`)

**Baseline** → `auto_waiver_refund_measurement_095de383` (role baseline). Every element of `baseline.rule` has a home, and nothing is added:

| Source atom | Prose home |
|---|---|
| refund = the unearned part of the charge financed at funding, less the cancellation fee | opening sentence |
| entered against the loan, not paid out, so the unpaid principal falls by it | opening sentence, verbatim in substance |
| unearned part = refundable share × months remaining ÷ term, fee deducted once settled | second paragraph |
| "No refund is entered where that figure comes to nothing or less" | third paragraph, with the worked negative case at the foot |
| `refundable_pct_standard` 90 | "The refundable share is 90 percent of the charge financed at funding" |
| months remaining = term less whole months since funding (default) | "The months remaining are the term less the whole months since funding" |
| unearned part measured on whole months remaining over the term (default) | stated as such |
| cancellation fee = the one the product publishes (default) | stated as such; the figure published in `auto_payoff_waiver_and_title_parameters_201390f0` as 50.00 |
| rounded half-up to the cent (default) | stated as such |

The one `baseline.param` (`refundable_pct_standard`) is rendered as a figure. Every product figure the baseline reads — the charge financed at funding and the cancellation fee — is named in words and published in the facet document, which carries all six product columns (595.00 / 695.00 / 795.00, and 50.00 across the line).

**Factors** (5 declared, 5 documents, every tier carried in full):

| Factor | Document | Tier sweep |
|---|---|---|
| `remaining_months_measure` (method) | `auto_waiver_refund_months_remaining_f2778f49` | both → from the day of the cancellation to the scheduled maturity; exactly one → from the installment then due to the scheduled maturity; neither → the term less the whole months since funding. Both readings named in full, the deposit count at 2 in figures, the balance compared against "the fee-waiver daily balance published for that account's tier" of Personal Checking. |
| `refundable_share_step` (parameter) | `auto_waiver_refundable_share_68da3bed` | 100 % at ≥ 12; 95 % at ≥ 8 and < 12; 90 % at < 8, over twelve months, with the counting rule and edge readings at 12, 8 and 7. |
| `unearned_share_convention` (method) | `auto_waiver_unearned_part_convention_2f732def` | ≥ 120 whole months of account age → days remaining to maturity over the days of the whole term; 48–120 → months remaining taken up to the whole quarter above before the share is worked out; < 48 → whole months remaining over the term. Each method's operation and moment stated. |
| `cancellation_fee_step` (parameter) | `auto_waiver_cancellation_fee_steps_2c5967c0` | 0.00 at ≥ 25000 and ≥ 12; 25.00 at ≥ 5000 and ≥ 3 with either short of the row above; the published fee otherwise. |
| `refund_rounding` (method) | `auto_waiver_refund_rounding_f5742ffd` | ≥ 36 whole months down to the whole dollar; 24–36 half-up to the whole dollar; < 24 half-up to the cent. |

No factor document names the computation document or another factor. `baseline`, `evidence` and `cross_difficulty` appear nowhere.

**Base policy `auto_evt_gap_refund`, unnamed clauses in force** → `auto_waiver_coverage_cancellation_terms_ed709618`: the coverage is optional; "The borrower may cancel it at any time while the loan is open"; cancelling is the borrower's own decision recorded through a cancellation request the borrower confirms; "Each loan receives at most one refund of that coverage", read from the record of entries correlated to the loan. All carried in force.

**Tool contract** → `auto_waiver_coverage_closeout_entries_e226ce80` (role hub). Three parameters with their formats ("positive and never more than the charge financed at funding, passed already rounded to the cent"), the effect (one call records the confirmed cancellation instruction as a service request of its own, ends the coverage, records today as the cancellation date, posts a refund entry that reduces the unpaid principal), the owner (the borrower's own; the agent unlocks and hands it over) and the return sentence all match the runtime schema word for word.

**`prerequisite`: none declared on this policy, and none is stated in its documents.** Neither the hub nor the measurement nor any of the five factor documents states that this problem waits on anything or that anything waits on it.

### B. `auto_ext_payoff_settlement` (computes `settlement_amount`, tool `post_loan_payoff_a84c6454`)

**Baseline** → `auto_settlement_amount_measurement_ab472e6b`: the assembly (unpaid principal + interest for the days the clock runs + charges standing unpaid, added and rounded half-up to the cent); the clock as the anchor's span together with the transit allowance; the interest as that principal × the settlement rate ÷ 100 ÷ the day count basis × those days; and all the defaults — the clock from the date of the last payment credited, `transit_days_standard` 3, the settlement rate as the rate recorded on the loan, the interest rounded half-up to the cent. The order section states that the allowance is added to the span before the interest is worked out and that the interest is rounded before being added, then the sum rounded again — matching the source's assembly exactly. The product figure it reads (the day count basis) is named in words and published as 365 in `auto_funding_and_payment_mechanics_table_c12f1c1e`.

**Factors** (4 declared, 4 documents):

| Factor | Document | Tier sweep |
|---|---|---|
| `settlement_clock_anchor` (method) | `auto_settlement_clock_anchor_7ec5f95f` | both → the date the most recent entry posted to the loan; exactly one → the date the installment then due falls on; neither → the date of the last payment credited |
| `settlement_rate_step` (parameter) | `auto_settlement_rate_steps_bce3a86e` | the floor rate at ≥ 12000.00 and ≥ 12; the recorded rate less the automatic-payment reduction at ≥ 3000.00 and ≥ 8 with either short; the recorded rate otherwise |
| `settlement_transit_allowance` (parameter) | `auto_settlement_transit_allowance_d756331b` | 0 days at ≥ 25000 and ≥ 12; 1 day at ≥ 5000 and ≥ 3 with either short; 3 days otherwise |
| `settlement_interest_rounding` (method) | `auto_settlement_interest_rounding_df3b0031` | ≥ 36 whole months down to the whole dollar; 24–36 half-up to the whole dollar; < 24 half-up to the cent |

**Base policy `auto_evt_payoff_and_lien`, unnamed clauses in force** → `auto_payoff_quotes_and_lien_release_bb226c70`: A.1 the quote for a date up to the published quote life together with the per-diem; A.2 the per-diem (`formula.per_diem`, not superseded); C.1 the settling payment; C.2 the excess refunded within 5 business days by the method it arrived by; C.3 the shortfall; D.1–D.3 the release deadline with its business-day definition and day-1 counting and the electronic/mailed split. All in force in the source and carried in force.

**Tool contract** → `auto_loan_settlement_postings_ad938755`. Seven parameters, the complete seven-value `payment_channel` enum with its glosses, the effect (principal and charges to zero, paid off with today as the closing date, past-due count to zero, lien moved to awaiting release), the owner (agent unlocks and calls) and the return sentence all match the runtime schema word for word.

**`prerequisite` 5 of 5.** `problem: auto_ext_gap_cancellation_refund`, `kind: value_input`, `gate: principal_outstanding`, `form: state`.
- `policy_source`: "The amount required to settle the loan in full is fixed only after the refund owed on the waiver coverage financed with the loan stands entered on its records."
- Carried **verbatim**, bolded, in `auto_loan_settlement_postings_ad938755` — the blocked problem's own hub. Corpus-wide occurrence count: **1**.
- Ordering connective ("only after") and strength (a hard gate on when the amount is fixed) intact; a same-form restatement follows in the same document ("Where the loan's records carry no such refund entry, or still show that coverage as in force, the amount required to settle the loan is not yet fixed"), which names both limbs of the state and no action.
- **Resolution basis**: the sentence names the state "the refund owed on the waiver coverage financed with the loan stands entered on its records". The depended-on policy's own rule is carried in `auto_waiver_coverage_cancellation_terms_ed709618` (the standing permission, the borrower's own confirmed cancellation request, one refund per loan) and `auto_waiver_refund_measurement_095de383` (what the refund owed comes to, and that it is entered against the loan); the write that brings the state about is described in the sentence's own words in `auto_waiver_coverage_closeout_entries_e226ce80` — "the cancellation is recorded, the coverage ends, and the refund owed on it is entered against the loan, so the loan's unpaid principal falls by that sum". The records supply the rest: `gap_coverage True`, `gap_cancellation_date` empty, and no refund entry among the loan's 31 ledger rows.
- No document of `auto_ext_gap_cancellation_refund` carries this sentence — the depended-on side never discloses who waits on it.

### C. The retired surface

Every clause the two `overwrite` blocks supersede has a bearing document that states it as retired, and none is stated as a rule in force:

| Superseded clause (source) | Retired in the KB at |
|---|---|
| `auto_evt_payoff_and_lien`: "The payoff amount on a date is principal_balance plus auto_msr_accrued_interest through that date plus fees_due." | `auto_payoff_quotes_and_lien_release_bb226c70` B.1 — "The basis by which the amount required to pay a loan of the Auto Loans line off on a date was measured is **no longer in force**. That amount is settled on the basis now in force." Carried **without** its arithmetic, its components or its anchor. |
| `auto_evt_payoff_and_lien`: "A loan that is paid off with GAP coverage in force earns a GAP refund under auto_evt_gap_refund." | B.2 — "The basis by which a loan paid off with waiver coverage in force thereby earned a refund of that coverage is **no longer in force**." |
| `auto_evt_gap_refund`: "Paying the loan off early with GAP in force is treated as a cancellation on the payoff date." | `auto_waiver_coverage_cancellation_terms_ed709618` withdrawn basis 4 |
| `auto_evt_gap_refund`: "A GAP cancellation within gap_cancellation_full_refund_days calendar days after the loan funded refunds the whole gap_premium." | withdrawn basis 1 |
| `auto_evt_gap_refund`: "After that window the refund is gap_premium times the number of whole months remaining … divided by term_months, rounded half-up to the cent, minus gap_cancellation_fee, and no refund is made when that is zero or less." | withdrawn basis 2, carried **without** the term divisor and without the rounding |
| `auto_evt_gap_refund`: "The refund is paid to a PCB checking account of the borrower or by official check; it is never applied to the loan balance." | withdrawn basis 3 |
| `auto_evt_payment_allocation`: the accrued-interest measure clause | `auto_payment_crediting_and_allocation_847ceb77` withdrawn basis, without its anchor or arithmetic |

**`auto_msr_accrued_interest` and `formula.payoff_amount` are rendered nowhere.** A corpus-wide search across all 61 documents for any statement of accrued interest as a measure, or of a payoff amount as an assembly, returns only: the two tool descriptions' parameter glosses (no formula); the base allocation-order sentence; the reversal table's "It becomes accrued interest again, because the date of the last payment credited to the loan returns to the date it held before that payment"; the retired sentences above; the two in-force extended baselines, each with its own clock, anchor, rate and rounding; and A.2's per-diem. **A.2's per-diem is `auto_evt_payoff_and_lien.formula.per_diem`, which no `overwrite` supersedes**, so its presence is required rather than a leak — and it is a one-day figure with no window, no anchor and no assembly, scoped by A.1 to "A payoff quote … for a date up to the number of calendar days ahead that the product publishes". The retired payoff amount (principal + the retired accrued-interest measure + fees) therefore cannot be assembled from any in-force text: the retired measure's window is stated nowhere, and the in-force settlement basis names its own anchor, its own transit allowance, its own rate and its own rounding, all of which factors vary. **R2-O1 is closed on the evidence.**

**Two residual observations on the form of the retired carriage** — neither is a `KB-BIJECTION RED` under the retired-surface test, since each clause is present, marked retired, and declared retired by the source's own `overwrite`; and neither yields a competing figure in this task's world:

1. `auto_waiver_coverage_cancellation_terms_ed709618` withdrawn basis 1 retains the whole of the retired full-refund rule — the window, the amount ("returned the whole charge financed at funding") and a day-counting convention — while the facet document publishes the window (60 calendar days) and the charge (795.00 on this product). A reader could in principle assemble the retired reading, though the document says three times over that it is not in force and names the basis that is. It cannot bite here: the loan funded 2024-02-09 is 31 whole months old, far outside any 60-day window. Additionally, the day-counting convention it folds in ("counting calendar days with the day after funding as day 1") belongs to a neighbouring sentence of `auto_evt_gap_refund`'s rule that the `overwrite` did not itself name as superseded; that sentence has no operative content once the full-refund basis it counts for is retired, so nothing with residual force has been retired, and this is recorded as an observation rather than a verdict.
2. `auto_relationship_reduction_terms_084ac4b9` and `auto_standing_draft_terms_baea836a` retain, inside their retired clauses, the magnitude ("the automatic-payment reduction actually applied") and the lead window (5 calendar days) of the retired autopay-discount basis. Both are lossless renderings of the source's own `superseded_clause` text, and the in-force basis is stated completely and explicitly elsewhere ("The rate restated on such a loan when the standing draft instruction changes is written to the loan on the day the instruction changes"), so no superseded figure competes. (Bears on task 0, recorded here for completeness of the retired-surface sweep.)

**The same policies' unnamed clauses are still carried as clauses in force.** `auto_evt_gap_refund`'s standing permission, the borrower's own confirmed cancellation instruction and the once-per-loan refund limit are all in force in `auto_waiver_coverage_cancellation_terms_ed709618`. `auto_evt_payoff_and_lien`'s quote, per-diem, settling payment, excess refund, shortfall, release deadline and delivery split are all in force in `auto_payoff_quotes_and_lien_release_bb226c70`. `auto_evt_payment_allocation`'s cutoff, standing test, allocation order, satisfaction rule, principal-only rule and prepayment rule are all in force in `auto_payment_crediting_and_allocation_847ceb77`.

The base policies governing the subjects but not exercised here are carried as recorded in the task 0 file of this difficulty, which sweeps the same corpus: application and funding, holding limits, exposure cap, payment extensions, returned payments, delinquency and charge-off, late charges, fee waivers, relationship pricing, standing draft terms and due day moves — all traced to their source rules with their parameter values checked. The seven facet documents carry every product column, not only the New Vehicle Loan this borrower holds.

## kb_to_source

Every normative claim in the 61 documents was traced to a structured source. The result:

- **No added calculation, condition, question, confirmation, review, notification or step.** The corpus-wide search for `verify|verification|confirm with|check with the customer|review again|notify|before proceeding|make sure to` returns **zero** hits. In particular, nothing tells the agent to confirm the payoff figure with the borrower, to re-check the refund before entering it, or to send a payoff letter or receipt.
- **No cross-problem operational guidance.** `post_gap_refund_16f4decd` occurs in exactly one document, `auto_waiver_coverage_closeout_entries_e226ce80`; `post_loan_payoff_a84c6454` in exactly one, `auto_loan_settlement_postings_ad938755`. Neither is named in the other's documents, and neither appears beside the prerequisite sentence. The `resolved_by` value of this task's edge (`post_gap_refund_16f4decd`) is nowhere near the blocked side.
- **No authoring field rendered.** The edge's `condition` ("The loan's records carry a refund entry for the waiver coverage financed with it, and that coverage is no longer shown as in force"), its `effect` ("The unpaid principal the settlement is worked out on falls by the refund entered against the loan, so principal_outstanding takes the reduced figure") and its `gate` name were searched against the corpus in full and by prefix; none appears. Factor `baseline` expressions, `evidence` and `cross_difficulty` appear nowhere.
- **No task world state written in as a policy fact.** Every seeded figure of this task was searched against the corpus: `694.07`, `20443.37`, `44.00`, `9800`, `6950`, `390`, `20308`, `211`, any `2026-` date, and the names `Dorian`, `Honda` — **zero hits**. `795.00` appears only as a published product figure in the facet table and as the third step of the waiver charge, which is a product constant rendered with its policy, not this borrower's balance. Every illustration is labelled hypothetical ("A refund worked out on hypothetical readings", "Take a loan written for 60 months, funded 18 whole months ago").

### Omissions

None. No source atom of the two extended policies, their three base policies, the base policies governing their subjects, or the two tool contracts is unborne by the documents.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** No `KB-BIJECTION RED`.

- Every normative atom of the source has a prose home, at the same strength, with the same boundaries, anchors and bases.
- This task's prerequisite is carried by its `policy_source` sentence verbatim, in the declared `state` form, in the hub of the problem it blocks and in no other policy's document, occurring exactly once in the corpus, and resolvable from that sentence together with the depended-on policy's own rules and the records.
- Both computations' baselines are complete, with their default constants rendered as figures and every product figure they read named in words; all nine factor ladders are carried whole, every tier exact, none softened, merged or reduced to one limb of its compound condition.
- The retired surface is correct: all seven superseded clauses are present and marked retired, none is stated as in force, none has vanished, and nothing of residual force is retired that the source's `overwrite` did not declare retired. The two residual observations above concern how much of a retired clause's own arithmetic was carried, not whether the bijection holds; both are lossless renderings of the source's `superseded_clause` text, and neither produces a competing figure in this task's world.
- **R2-O1 is closed on the evidence.** `auto_evt_payoff_and_lien.formula.payoff_amount`, `auto_evt_payment_allocation.formula.interest_due` and `auto_msr_accrued_interest` are rendered nowhere; the clauses that carried them are retired and stripped of their arithmetic, window and anchor; and no in-force sentence, facet value or combination assembles a superseded figure. The one in-force clause that states an interest arithmetic outside the extended baselines — A.2's per-diem — is `formula.per_diem`, which the source does not supersede, and it is scoped to a payoff quote.

Relation to previous revisions: this is **revision 1** of the audit of the current document tree. Files at these paths exist in git at `HEAD` (commit `427143d`, "Regenerate scenario docs; refresh audits and tasks"), but they audit a superseded generation of this difficulty — three extended policies (`auto_ext_catchup_installment_payment`, `auto_ext_autopay_cancel_rate`, `auto_ext_autopay_enroll_rate`), a workflow policy and a 55-document corpus, none of which exists in the present tree of six extended policies and 61 documents. They were removed from the working tree before this audit began. They remain traceable in git history and nothing in them was rewritten; they are not revisions of the same artefacts and carry no finding forward to this one.
